message.content:
This editorial illustration presents a vertical scene dominated by a man viewed from behind, standing before a vast body of water. The man wears a light-colored, long-sleeved shirt, matching trousers, a dark red waist sash, and a black songkok cap. His right hand points toward the horizon, where the white numbers "2024" appear faintly above the water's surface. His left hand is held by another person's hand, visible in the lower-left foreground from a first-person perspective. The sky transitions from orange-brown near the horizon to dark gray clouds above.

The "TEMPO" logo is prominent at the top in large, black serif letters. Other text includes "ANCANG-ANCANG PRABOWO" in large white sans-serif font on the right. Below this, smaller white text reads: "Prabowo Subianto dan Partai Gerindra mulai bergerilya mencari calon wakil presiden. Jokowi disebut memintanya mencari kandidat berlatar Nahdlatul Ulama. H.22". Additional headings at the top read "Modus Konflik Lahan Sentul City H.60" and "Lintang Pukang Investasi Telkomsel H.70". A barcode and QR code are in the upper-right corner.
